cap: First learn: rings every 4 cm, 8 points each. The outline is there; shoulders balloon.
Rings every 2 cm, three times the points on the torso. The face starts to show.
Smoothing and simplifying: rings a straight plane can stand in for are dropped. Fewer, bigger planes.
Deltoids split off the chest and carried up with the arms. Little posts at the shoulder tops (a bug).
Posts fixed. 97% outline match from every side, 1,700 faces, but no tank-top edges or fingers.
Words test 1: "flatter pecs, big planes like the picture".
Words test 2: "make his forearms 20% bigger". It works, but the ring-only body loses the face.
The cage idea: keep Meshy's own surface and let the rings drive it. First try cracked along texture seams.
Seams welded: 3,000 faces, 99% match from every side, face, fingers and tank top kept.
Both word edits through the cage: flatter pecs and bigger forearms, with all the detail kept.
